premises.text: Tourists desire authentic dining experiences and want to meet locals while traveling
premises.evidence_span: Most of the tourists want to meet the locals and to have an authentic dining experience.

premises.text: There is a basic human need to share food with others that exists across cultures and time
premises.evidence_span: we understood that this basic human need to share food with others existed in the past, it exists in the present, and it will continue to exist in the future.

premises.text: Eat With provides a platform that structures and ensures safety and trust for dining experiences
premises.evidence_span: simply put business structure, safety, and trust around this phenomena, and make it accessible to tens of millions more around the world.

premises.text: Eat With can disrupt the traditional restaurant industry by creating a new dining category
premises.evidence_span: this is about disrupting a $1.9 trillion restaurant industry with a whole new dining category.

premises.text: Local hosts can earn income by providing dining experiences through the platform
premises.evidence_span: Eat With lets me do this, while earning some extra income.

premises.text: The platform has successfully attracted both tourists and locals for various dining events
premises.evidence_span: 50% of all our booking during our pilot came from locals.

value.text: Consumers gain access to authentic dining experiences with locals

notes: Pilot success in Tel Aviv and Barcelona is excluded as traction.
